newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CHEMAPOL BUYS KORAMO REFINERY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CHEMAPOL BUYS KORAMO REFINERY.

text.p: Czech chemical and engineering conglomerate Chemapol Group a.s. said on Tuesday it finalised its purchase of a 52.3 percent stake in refinery Koramo Kolin a.s. from the Czech state-run National Property Fund (NPF).
Chemapol said in a statement it has already paid for hte stake, but did nopt reveal any details of the transaction.
"By its equity participation in Koramo Kolin a.s. Chemapol follows the aim of maintaining and developing the traditional area of high-quality refinery prduction," the statement said.

It added that Chemapol was planning to strenghten the position of Koramo's Mogul engine lubricant brand, and extend the range of production "to a full range of lubricants and oils according to the demands of customers".

Chemapol was originally an oil trading company but has developed into into a holding company of chemical, engineering, arms and chemicals distribution comapnies, including the petrol station network called Petra.
